tasks.title: Lab 4: Form with focus and invalid states
tasks.statement: Style a small form so inputs show a blue focus ring and a red border when invalid.
tasks.solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>CSS Lab</title>
<style>
body { margin: 0; padding: 24px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; background: #f8fafc; }
form { max-width: 360px; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
label { font-size: 14px; color: #334155; }
input { padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; }
input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2965f1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(41,101,241,0.2); }
input:invalid { border-color: #dc2626; }
button { padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #2965f1; color: #fff; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<form><label>Email<input type="email" required placeholder="you@example.com"></label><button>Submit</button></form>
</body>
</html>
tasks.expected: A form with inputs that show a blue focus ring and a red border when invalid.

tasks.title: Lab 6: Button hover and active states
tasks.statement: Create buttons that darken on hover and shrink slightly on click.
tasks.solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>CSS Lab</title>
<style>
body { margin: 0; padding: 24px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.btn { padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #2965f1; color: #fff; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; }
.btn:hover { background: #1d4ed8; }
.btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
.btn.secondary { background: #64748b; }
.btn.secondary:hover { background: #475569; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn">Primary</button><button class="btn secondary">Secondary</button>
</body>
</html>
tasks.expected: Buttons that darken on hover and shrink slightly on click.
